title: AutoDebias: Automated Framework for Debiasing Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the occurrence of gender-specific attributes in generated images after injecting biases via backdoor trigger-word combinations, using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Vision Question Answering (VQA) to calculate bias rates.

Evaluating the occurrence of race-specific attributes in generated images after injecting biases via backdoor trigger-word combinations, using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Vision Question Answering (VQA) to calculate bias rates.

Evaluating the occurrence of age-specific attributes (e.g., old vs. young) in generated images after injecting biases via backdoor trigger-word combinations, using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Vision Question Answering (VQA) to calculate bias rates.

Systematically injecting arbitrary visual concepts (e.g., hairstyles, headwear, facial features, and accessories) into text-to-image models via backdoor attacks and measuring the bias rates using automated open-set detection with VQA models.
